ambient_events: The stairwell fire door drifts open an inch and settles.
A mailbox door hangs open, ticking against its frame in the draft.
Somewhere above, a TV murmurs through a floor.
The dead elevator's call button glows, hopeful and useless.
description: The ground-floor lobby of Chrome Court: a bank of tenant mailboxes, most jimmied, and an elevator with a hand-lettered OUT OF ORDER SINCE sign where the date has been scratched out and re-guessed by successive residents. A stairwell climbs into the amber gloom of the upper floors behind a fire door that no longer latches. A resident's bicycle is chained to the radiator with more security than the front door offers. It is quiet, and locked, and warm, and that is enough.
name: Chrome Court — Lobby
